source_drift_since_prompt4.explanation: Count movement between Prompt 4 and Prompt 5 reflects live Royal Caribbean catalogue changes (source movement) plus the 20 database inserts from Batch 1. Simple subtraction previous_outstanding - 100 is invalid unless the source snapshot is unchanged.

pre_post_source_drift.note: Outstanding eligible insert counts can change due to live source movement as well as database inserts. Do not assume previous_outstanding - inserted = new_outstanding.
